text: Figure 7.16: Description of nested usage of ExclusiveArea [TPS_SWCT_01049] Two ways to use the ExclusiveAreas ⌈There are in general two ways to use the ExclusiveAreas. During its execution, a RunnableEntity can enter and exit an ExclusiveArea (in which case ExecutableEntity.canEnter shall exist). As an alternative, it can be specified that the entire execution of a given RunnableEntity shall be guarded by an ExclusiveArea (this requires the existence of ExecutableEntity.runsInside).⌋ emplate
